paper_title: A New Bound on Axion-Like Particles
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of Figure 6
notes: Marsh et al. (arXiv:1703.07354): astrophysical ALP-photon conversion limit from absence of spectral irregularities in Chandra X-ray spectrum of the M87 AGN in the Virgo cluster. Not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density assumed. Headline conservative bound (B0=35 uG model, robust to magnetic field modeling): g_agamma < 2.6e-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL, mass-independent for m_a <= 1e-13 eV; encoded as a flat two-point line spanning down to very low mass (bound valid for all m_a below 1e-13 eV, weakening above and losing to SN1987A near 3e-12 eV). Stronger baseline model bounds also quoted: 1.49e-12 (B0=31.5 uG) and 1.17e-12 (B0=40 uG) GeV^-1.
